en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing heavy wartime destruction in an urban area. Ruined buildings line the street, with collapsed walls and rubble in the foreground. At the center stands the damaged shell of a large church or similar structure with a tall tower. The overall atmosphere is bleak, with a few small human figures amid the debris. Caption text is printed at the bottom in Dutch.
